SR2E.MxIc97.ownerOnly: Only {name}'s owner or the GM can do that.
SR2E.MxIc97.Why.improviseOff: An improvised attack needs a jacked-in decker (and the book's improvised attacks rule).
SR2E.MxIc97.Why.improviseNone: Take at least 1 point from Evasion or Bod for the improvised attack's Power.
SR2E.MxIc97.Why.improviseMore: The persona doesn't have that many points of Evasion or Bod to give.
SR2E.MxIc97.Why.improviseMpcp: An improvised attack's Power may not be above the MPCP ({mpcp}).
SR2E.MxIc97.Suppress.crashed: {ic} crashes. {decker} may let it count ({points} on their security tally) or suppress it (Detection Factor −1 while in this host; VR2 p. 40).
SR2E.MxIc97.Suppress.countLine: {decker}'s security tally +{points} (crashed IC or a data bomb).
SR2E.MxIc97.Suppress.notCrashed: {name} hasn't crashed: only crashed IC can be suppressed.
SR2E.MxIc97.Suppress.done: {decker} suppresses {name}: Detection Factor now {df} while in this host.
SR2E.MxIc97.Suppress.released: {decker} releases {name}: the Detection Factor point is back, and {points} go on the security tally.
SR2E.MxIc97.Bomb.name: Data bomb ({where})
SR2E.MxIc97.Bomb.choice: A data bomb goes off on {where}. {decker} may let it count ({points} on their security tally) or suppress it (Detection Factor −1 while in this host; VR2 p. 41).
SR2E.MxIc97.BlackIc.lastShot: has {decker} down: before the connection goes, it takes a last shot at the MPCP as blaster IC with double its rating ({rating}). If the MPCP is destroyed, the run's downloads are deleted (VR2 p. 48).
SR2E.MxIc97.BlackIc.wiped: The MPCP of {deck} is destroyed (rating 0): {files} file(s) downloaded this run are deleted.
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.name: Improvised attack
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.option: Improvise one (a Simple Action: points from Evasion and Bod)
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.test: {decker} writes an attack program (Computer {computer} vs TN {tn})
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.readyNote: Evasion −{evasion}, Bod −{bod} until it is used (one attack).
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.failedNote: Evasion −{evasion}, Bod −{bod} until the decker's next action.
SR2E.MxIc97.Improvise.restore: Next action: restore Evasion and Bod
SR2E.MxIc97.Maneuver.position: {name} gains position on {target} ({mine} vs {theirs}): {net} off the TN or onto the Power of their next attack on them.
SR2E.MxIc97.Maneuver.backfires: The maneuver backfires ({mine} vs {theirs}): {target} gets {net} off the TN of their next attack on {name}.
SR2E.MxIc97.Maneuver.parry: {name} parries ({mine} vs {theirs}): +{net} TN on {target}'s next attack on them.
SR2E.MxIc97.Maneuver.evade: {name} evades {target} ({mine} vs {theirs}): IC finds them again after {net} Combat Turn(s), 1 sooner for every point on their security tally meanwhile.
SR2E.MxIc97.Ripper.loss: {loss} off {deck}'s {attr} chip for good (replace the chip).
SR2E.MxIc97.Tar.defense: {program} resists the tar ({dice} dice vs TN {tn})
SR2E.MxIc97.Tar.pitTest: Tar Pit Test: {ic} {rating} vs MPCP + Hardening {tn}
SR2E.MxIc97.Tar.corrupts: The viral code corrupts every copy in the deck: the utility is lost until reloaded from outside the deck after jacking out.
SR2E.MxIc97.Tar.defeated: The viral code is defeated: reload the utility with a Swap Memory operation.
SR2E.MxIc97.Scramble.test: Poison Test: {file}'s scramble IC {rating} vs Computer {tn}
SR2E.MxIc97.Scramble.suppressed: The decker suppresses the poison IC's destruct code: the data survives.
SR2E.MxIc97.Filter.holds: The filter holds: its level of Response Increase stays in {host}.
SR2E.MxIc97.Filter.fails: The filter fights {host}'s sculpture: −2 Reaction and −1D6 Initiative here (its Response Increase level is lost).
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__suppress: Suppressing IC: when IC crashes (or a data bomb goes off) the decker chooses the tally or −1 Detection Factor, VR2 p. 40 (book) or the tally at once (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__blackIcKi: Black IC's last shot: killing or knocking out the decker, it hits the MPCP at double rating and may wipe the run's data, VR2 p. 48 (book) or nothing more (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__improvise: Improvised attacks: Power from Evasion and Bod, Computer vs Power for the level, VR2 p. 123 (book) or none (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__parry: Parry maneuver: lasts until the opponent's next attack, no cap, VR2 p. 122 (book) or until the next Combat Turn ends (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__position: Position maneuver: the winner (it can backfire) gets −TN or +Power on its next attack, VR2 p. 122 (book) or −TN for the decker only, a turn long (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__evade: Evade detection: IC finds the icon again after net Combat Turns, 1 sooner per tally point, VR2 p. 121 (book) or a turn long (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__ripper: Ripper IC: cripples the icon, then a Ripper Test vs MPCP + Hardening takes 1 per success off the chip, VR2 p. 43 (book) or the loss goes on the deck (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__tar: Tar baby and tar pit: opposed rating tests, both crash, tar pit's corruption test vs MPCP + Hardening, VR2 pp. 42–43 (book) or the IC's attack test (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__scramble: Scramble IC: poison scramble's Poison Test vs Computer after a failed decryption, VR2 p. 42 (book) or the file is destroyed (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__dataBomb: Data bombs: defuse vs the subsystem with the Defuse utility, all 1s sets it off; the blast's rating on the tally unless suppressed, VR2 p. 41 (book) or Decrypt vs the rating and an alert (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__coolInit: Running cool: 1D6 less Matrix Initiative, VR2 p. 85 (book) or none (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__realityFi: Reality filters: one more level of Response Increase (5 at most) and MPCP −1, lost where a sculpted host's test fails, VR2 pp. 84, 87 (book) or the old Reaction and pool bonus (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXIC_V97__nonCombat: Non-combat actions: Reaction ÷ 10 (round up) + 1 per extra Initiative die per turn, shown on the persona, VR2 p. 120 (book) or not shown (v965)
